title: Verify all crates at 90% coverage and refresh badges
description:
Confirm the coverage goal is met across all production crates and that the published badges reflect it.

## Background

This is the epic closeout. With the measurement exclusion in place and the per-crate test work done, a final CI coverage run should show every production crate at or above 90% and deploy the updated badges.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-1: A CI coverage run reports library line coverage at or above 90.0% for each of gf2-core, gf2-coding, gf2-algebra, gf2-sim, and gf2-kernels-simd.
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-2: The badges deployed to the `badges` branch show those numbers, and the README references resolve to them.
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-3: No fast-tier test-suite regression: the workspace test battery stays green within its wall-clock budget.

## Notes

This task only verifies and reports; it does not add new tests. If a crate falls short, the gap routes back to that crate's task rather than being patched here.
